Preserve original age, Sex, immunotherapy type, highest irAEgrade, cohort and sequencing batch literally, including cohort NA. Immunotherapy type is a clinical regimen descriptor; highest irAEgrade is a subsequent clinical outcome, not an exposure at specimen collection or a model prediction. Public processed digital count tables are usable; unavailable original raw sequencing reads are not reconstructed or claimed acquired.

source_metadata.cell_calling_policy: Own fixed RNAQC is applied to all provided observations; no reproduction of author full cell/doublet selection.
